adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: At the Avengers' party Steve budges Thor's hammer Mjolnir, to Thor's alarm, and the two fight Ultron's army side by side in Sokovia.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate, alarmed when Steve budges Mjolnir at a party.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who budges Mjolnir at the Avengers' party.
adds.evidence: Party Mjolnir-lifting game (Steve moves it slightly, Thor looks worried); both fight in the Battle of Sokovia.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Steve clashes with Tony over building Ultron and over giving J.A.R.V.I.S. a new body, but they fight side by side in Sokovia and part warmly at the new Avengers base.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Steve clashes with over Ultron, then fights beside in Sokovia.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who clashes with Tony over Ultron, then fights beside him in Sokovia.
adds.evidence: Plot: the Avengers fight among themselves over uploading J.A.R.V.I.S.; both fight in Sokovia; Stark leaves the new base as Rogers stays to train new Avengers.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: Thor grabs Tony by the throat after Ultron, the program Tony built, attacks the team. In Sokovia they overload Ultron's machine together and shatter the falling city.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The builder of Ultron. Overloads Ultron's machine alongside Thor.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who grabs Tony by the throat over Ultron.
adds.evidence: Plot: 'Stark and Thor overload the machine and shatter the landmass'; Thor chokes Stark after Ultron's attack on Avengers Tower.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: At the Avengers' party Natasha passes on trying to lift Thor's hammer, and they fight Ultron as teammates from Johannesburg to Sokovia.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who passes on trying to lift Thor's hammer.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate whose hammer Natasha passes on trying to lift.
adds.evidence: Both at the party's Mjolnir game; both in the Johannesburg fight and the Battle of Sokovia as Avengers.

adds.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
adds.text: After Bruce's rampage as the Hulk in Johannesburg, Clint hides him and the rest of the team at his secret family farmhouse.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who hides Bruce at his family's farmhouse.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Clint hides at his farmhouse after the Hulk's rampage.
adds.evidence: Plot: backlash over the Hulk's destruction sends the team into hiding at Barton's farmhouse with his family.
